Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You step into one pool of shadow and emerge from another, carrying its chill with you.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Your shadowed square and one visible free shadowed square within 3 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Step from one shadow into the other: move yourself to the chosen destination without crossing intervening squares. No opaque barrier between them; teleportation does not provoke.
